title: BFF-ADM-054 current BFF administration through actual UI

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given Admin A uses subject "admin-a" with role "FMO_ADMIN" in an isolated authenticated browser
2. And the controlled Import Map fixture records the initial grid rows and persisted values
3. And the Import Map primary save persists record 101 before its controlled audit write fails
4. And Admin A has received the error response for that save
5. When Admin A reloads the browser page containing Import Map administration page
6. Then the Import Map data grid contains exactly one row with "Record Id" equal to "101" on the Import Map administration page
7. And in the Import Map data grid with column "Record Id", that row displays the values returned by the persisted-record readback on the Import Map administration page
8. And the request log contains no additional create request after the reload

annotations.description: Actual current React and exact-current BFF admin controllers/services/JPA with actual migration DDL in disposable PostgreSQL. Controlled OUD/EMS2 identities and local Spring bootstrap. Fixture SQL seeds/mutates isolated records; service errors are actual database errors. Undefined agreed messages remain unresolved acceptance.

limits: The recorded assertions and environment binding limit the supported business result.
